lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Nb2Co2 (reduced formula Mg6NbCo) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Co, Mg, and Nb centers in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements; the Co and Nb environments each contain 8 Co/Mg plus 4 Mg or Nb neighbors, while Mg environments include combinations of Co, Mg, and Nb. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra with corner, edge, and face sharing, and Mg–Nb polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
